title: Craftable Feathers
description: Adds crafting recipe for feathers. Different variations od recipes are possible. Also adds "Wooden Feathers", that can be used in crafting exactly like normal feathers and as a fuel source
body:
# Craft Feathers easily!
![Most simple recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d1e002a20ac591e37e106e2cc310f05b7ed8d1f3.png)

There are also other recipes for more feathers:

![recipe using breeze rods](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e7880f6f84421d4b62669ce74166d4c035c370d4.png)
![recipe using blaze rods](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/04b5835ac2835b940ee78b7690b31e743f1911f3.png)

## But wait, there's more:
You can now craft "Wooden Feathers" that can be used in crafting just like normal feathers but is also a fuel source.

![wooden feather crafting recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/9867d2523c7bd55d61c2febca5cb3023612e8f75.png)
![Wooden feathers used as fuel source](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/1903da4db179f227e44ad1a95c79a5715b76aed9.png)
